angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 478,642 km at 438.52 pc = 0.01 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.2804 +/- 0.3995 mas (same row, RUWE 16.36): 438.52 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.688 +/- 0.048 solar radii from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html): 478,642 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.768 +/- 0.024 solar masses from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4500 +/- 123 K from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-1795 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-1795.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.648, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-1795 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.28 dex, from Q1-Q17 DR25 KOI Table (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-1795 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.757, from Calculated Value (/docs/pscp_calc.html)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-1795 (pscomppars): age 5.8 Gyr, from Q1-Q8 KOI Table (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, Kepler-1795: projected rotation speed 3.27 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2022ApJS..259...35A)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
